Legacy pullback hypothesis LKO-PULLBACK-001 is only partially matched: breadth proxy deterioration and ETH/BTC weakness are present, but several requested sensors are unavailable, divergent, or not established as canonical evidence. Any related forecast candidate remains unratified.
